主要内容: Subaru of America, Inc. introduced its first production hybrid model, the XV Crosstrek Hybrid, at the 2013 New York International Auto Show. The model is based on the popular XV Crosstrek crossover and features a 2.0-liter BOXER engine combined with a 13.4-hp electric motor integrated into the Lineartronic® Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT). A 100v, 13.5kw nickel-metal hydride battery is located under the revised rear floor area. The hybrid system weighs 209 lbs., and the vehicle weighs approximately 300 lbs. more than the gasoline model. The XV Crosstrek Hybrid retains the Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive and chassis capability of the gasoline model, offering the same utility and versatility while enhancing handling, steering, and ride. Additional features include improved sound insulation, a start/stop function, revised HVAC, a new gauge cluster, keyless start, and other enhancements. The model will be available in Subaru dealerships in the fourth quarter of 2013.
